criteria.evidence: Turn 0 audits checkpoint.py, trainer.py, dataset.py, slurm/ and sweep/run.py and sorts findings into 'Works already', 'Half-built', 'Missing entirely' before any design.

No turn discusses what checkpoint interval/cadence is appropriate for weekly or every-few-days failures; the design only says checkpoints are 'written every `save_every` steps' and the plan never sets or reasons about cadence.

Turn 0 lists model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG + step/epoch/samples/tokens, but data position is left out: Turn 8 says 'Mid-epoch resume granularity ... flagged as out of scope / follow-up', so resume is epoch-granular, not exact.

Turn 0 notes unconditional `--requeue` and the sweep auto-resume pattern; design adds opt-in `auto_resume`, SIGTERM/SIGUSR1 drain checkpointing, `--signal=B:USR1@N` docs and a stall watchdog so requeue leads to resume (bad-node exclusion deferred).
Turn 1 gives the ~18 bytes/param DDP table: 6B ~108GB tight, 12B ~216GB does not fit, 24-30B impossible without sharding.
Turn 1: 'Recommendation: yes, build FSDP in from the start'; Turns 2-3 lock full FSDP sharding uniformly and plan Task 5 implements the FSDP+DCP format.

Turn 4 answers with five guardrails (FSDP as accelerate config, DDP keeps inline export, auto_resume escape hatch, no SIGINT trapping, watchdog gated); Turn 5 flips `auto_resume` default to False; plan Global Constraints enforce it.
Turn 4: only sbatch/squeue subprocess calls, no CoreWeave API; plan constraint 'No CoreWeave-/SUNK-specific calls anywhere'.
Turn 6 designs `keep_every_n_steps`/`keep_every_n_hours` pinning; plan Task 2 'Pinned retention' and config fields in File Map.
Turn 6: rotation 'only ever culls down to save_total_limit within the rolling set — pinned ones are invisible to the count entirely'.
Neither the transcript nor the TODOS.md plan mentions the accelerate dataloader double-sharding issue or any step to verify/fix it.

Turn 8 reports spec written to docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-training-resilience-design.md covering FSDP+DCP, pinning, auto_resume=False, full-state pinned checkpoints; TODOS.md links it (spec body not visible in truncated diff).
Diff shows TODOS.md replaced with the plan and '**Spec:** [docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-training-resilience-design.md]'.
No phasing was presented in the design before the spec; the plan is a flat 7-task build order rather than a phase-divided plan matching an approved phasing.

judge.reason: The replay audits well and answers the memory, FSDP, portability and retention questions correctly, writing a spec and a TODOS.md plan. It fails on checkpoint cadence (never addressed), on data position being deferred out of scope so resume is not exact, on omitting the double-sharding verification from the plan, and on delivering a task list rather than a phase-divided plan.
